notification sound.note: Untranslated in current it.json; standard Italian rendering.

share extension.note: Untranslated in current it.json; matches Apple's Italian terminology for share extensions.

bottom sheet.note: Mostly developer-facing; often kept as 'bottom sheet' in Italian technical writing.

swipe.note: Existing: 'Scorri a sinistra su un server'. Imperative 'Scorri'.

long-press.note: Existing: 'Premere a lungo su un elemento'. Prefer informal imperative 'Premi a lungo' in instructions, matching the app's 'tu' register.

toast.note: No existing signal; often kept as 'toast' in developer contexts. Use 'avviso a comparsa' only if user-facing.

clipboard.note: Existing consistent: 'copiato negli appunti'. Masculine plural: 'gli appunti'.

biometrics.note: Adjective: 'biometrico' ('autenticazione biometrica'). Existing strings paraphrase ('protetto da un codice') rather than translate directly.

passcode.note: Apple's Italian term for passcode is 'codice'; existing string: 'protetto da un codice'. Use 'codice di sblocco' when ambiguity with other codes is possible.

jailbroken.note: Existing keeps English ('dispositivi jailbroken'); invariable adjective. Android equivalent 'rooted' is also kept. Paraphrase 'sottoposto a jailbreak' if a fuller Italian form is needed.

app logs.note: 'log' kept in English, masculine invariable ('i log'), matching existing 'i log del server'. Header form: 'LOG DELL'APP'.

deep link.note: Commonly kept in English in Italian software; masculine: 'il deep link', plural 'i deep link'.

skin tone.note: Majority in existing settings strings ('Tonalità della pelle predefinita'); emoji-name strings inconsistently use 'tono della pelle' and 'carnagione' — prefer 'tonalità della pelle'.

playback speed.note: Untranslated in current it.json; standard Italian media term.

server connection.note: 'server' stays in English. Existing UI: 'Aggiungi un server' (Add a server); Switch server = 'Cambia server'.
